definitions.explanation: The month after this one; the coming month. Used to refer to future events or plans in the month that follows the current one.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I'm going on a trip next month.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{新|あたら}しい{仕事|しごと}を{始|はじ}めます。
examples.english: I'm starting a new job from next month.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}の{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}しますか。
examples.english: Will you attend next month's meeting?

notes: Part of a time reference series: {先月|せんげつ} (last month), {今月|こんげつ} (this month), {来月|らいげつ} (next month). The {来|らい} prefix means 'coming' or 'next' and also appears in {来週|らいしゅう} (next week) and {来年|らいねん} (next year).
